lessons.title: Tensors, autograd & nn.Module
lessons.description: Train and debug neural networks directly.
lessons.conceptOverview: Tensors carry shape, dtype and device. Broadcasting aligns dimensions from the right. Autograd records differentiable operations; backward accumulates gradients into leaf tensors. An nn.Module registers parameters and child layers so optimizers and checkpoints can discover them.

sections.title: Try it yourself
sections.content: Trace the shapes of a batched linear layer. Compare a finite-difference gradient with the gradient computed by autograd.

lessons.title: Data pipelines & training loops
lessons.description: Train and debug neural networks directly.
lessons.conceptOverview: Split training and validation data before fitting preprocessing. Dataset defines examples; DataLoader handles batching and shuffling. Each training step clears gradients, runs the forward pass, computes loss, backpropagates and updates parameters. Validation uses eval mode and disables gradient recording; these are separate controls.

lessons.title: GPU training, precision & debugging
lessons.description: Train and debug neural networks directly.
lessons.conceptOverview: Move both inputs and parameters to the same device. Mixed precision can reduce activation memory, but sensitive reductions may need higher precision. FP16 often needs loss scaling. Profile data loading before adding GPUs; distributed data parallelism replicates the model and synchronizes gradients.

sections.title: Try it yourself
sections.content: Build a small classifier in a local PyTorch environment. Compare CPU and GPU step time, validation loss and checkpoint restoration. Report warmup separately.
